steps.caption: Cardiology worklist. One patient record, with every result received for this patient.
The banner states what is incomplete: 1 not received, 4 unverified.
One row per received document. The status shows how each result arrived.
Structured: coded on receipt. Converted: local code and unit mapped on receipt.
Unverified: value read from an image or report text. Not received: no electronic result.
External laboratory report from Regiolab Zuid, sent with the laboratory's own codes and units.
Troponin T, reported by the sender as 0,363 µg/L.
Converted on receipt to the hospital's unit: × 1000 → 363 ng/L.
Mapped to LOINC 67151-1. The original value is retained with the result.
Transthoracic echocardiogram: no structured report. The values were read from the exported image.
LVEF 64 %, read from the image by optical character recognition. Verification required.
The clinician checks the value against the image and verifies it (V).
Verified, with user and time recorded. The banner now shows 3 results unverified.
CT calcium score 398 Agatston, taken from the report text. It remains unverified until checked.
Not received: a point-of-care troponin from Heuvelland Ziekenhuis, reported by fax only.
Result request (R). It goes to the emergency department through ZorgMail, the network both hospitals already use.
An upload link is only the fallback, for a sender without any network. The sender signs in with a UZI pass.
Request sent through ZorgMail and recorded on the result.
Referral (S) to Heuvelland Ziekenhuis through Twiin, with the received documents enclosed.
A clinical question is mandatory. Until it is entered, the referral cannot be sent.

steps.type: Back-referral after chest pain work-up. Please continue follow-up.

steps.caption: Recipient receives: each result, and how it is transmitted.
Converted results keep their original value. Unverified values are sent as images, marked unverified.
Referral sent and recorded in the patient's audit trail.
Management: results by source and by department, for all patients.
Point-of-care testing: 7 results, all reported by fax and none received electronically.
Results to Resolve: an external laboratory report with no BSN and no match on name and date of birth.
Match it to the patient or reject the message. The source message is kept as received.
